focal_point: One product hero beside a clean lifestyle photograph, and one color-blocked offer.
eye_path: From the lifestyle photograph to the product, then to the single offer.
grid: A photograph, a product, and one offer. The back holds a 2×2 benefit grid.
scale_ratios: Chunky condensed display type. The offer is the one loud element.
type_choices: One condensed display face, used large. Body type stays quiet.
photo_art_direction: A clean lifestyle photograph and one product hero. Not a cluttered scene.
offer_placement: One color-blocked percent offer. A pill-shaped code sits with that offer, not alone.
trust_and_cta: The back earns the front with a 2×2 icon benefit grid. One code, one offer.
emulate: A disciplined three-color palette, chunky condensed display type, a clean lifestyle photograph plus one product hero, a back with a 2×2 icon benefit grid, and one bold color-blocked offer panel with a pill-shaped code. Learn the discipline. Do not copy the layout.
do_not_copy: The mark, the colors, the offer figure, the code, the product, the photographs, the exact panel, and the wording.
anti_patterns: Do not turn the offer panel, the benefit grid, or the three colors into a template to trace.
summary: Owner favorite. Wondercide mosquito and tick postcard, both faces. The lesson is a three-color palette, condensed display type, a lifestyle photograph plus a product hero, a 2×2 benefit grid on the back, and one color-blocked offer with a pill-shaped code. Style reference only.
